summary: Expose HTMLFormElement.elements as a live HTMLFormControlsCollection with named access semantics.

target.notes: Return a live collection of listed form-associated elements in tree/form-owner order, with HTMLFormControlsCollection named lookup behavior.

caveats: Snapshot lists are incorrect; controls associated using form= can participate even outside the form subtree.

tests.name: collection is live
tests.input: const f=document.createElement('form'); const c=f.elements; const i=document.createElement('input'); f.append(i); console.log(c.length);

tests.name: named access finds controls
tests.input: const f=document.createElement('form'); const i=document.createElement('input'); i.name='x'; f.append(i); console.log(f.elements.namedItem('x')===i);
